title_sq: Ne Zonen E Tiranes Re, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Totalisht I Investuar!!
description_sq: Ne Zonen e Tiranes Re, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Totalisht E Investuar. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje zone mjafte te mire, persa i perket nivelit te jeteses, qetesise, aksesit me zonat qendrore dhe shume elementeve te tjere. Ndodhet ne katin e 4 baim te nje pallati te ri, te pajisur me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar. Organizohet ne nje strukture perfekte, salloni teper i madh qe sherben per pjesen e ndjenjes dhe ngrenies me vete, dy dhoma gjumi teper te bollshme, dy tualete me dritare dhe nje ballkon. Apartamenti shitet ne gjendjen sic eshte i pasqyruar totalisht i mobiluar. Ne vitin 2022 apartamenti eshte restauruar dhe rinovuar totalisht nga e para. Investimi i kryer eshte ne vleren e mbi 60 mije euro, ku perfshihet parket, mobiljet e te gjithe ambienteve, sistemi elektrik italian Vitrom shume i kushtueshem, sistemi kondicionimi inverter, elektroshtepiake te markave me cilesore, vetrata tripelx me gaz, hidrosanitare italiane ceramica sospeso etj. Apartamenti orientohet nga Jugu, gje qe e ben te ngrohte dhe te ndricuar gjate gjithe dites. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the New Tirana area, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Totally Invested!!
description_en: In the New Tirana area, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Totally Invested. The apartment is located in a very good area, in terms of standard of living, quietness, access to central areas and many other elements. It is located on the 4th floor of a new building, equipped with an elevator and well managed. It is organized in a perfect structure, a very large living room that serves as a sitting and dining area, two very spacious bedrooms, two bathrooms with windows and a balcony. The apartment is sold in the condition as shown, fully furnished. In 2022, the apartment was completely restored and renovated from scratch. The investment made is worth more than 60 thousand euros, which includes parquet, furniture of all rooms, very expensive Italian Vitrom electric system, inverter air conditioning system, high-quality household appliances, triplex gas windows, Italian ceramica sospeso sanitary ware, etc. The apartment faces South, which makes it warm and bright throughout the day. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
